highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves platform compatibility, rendering performance, and native WebGPU support.
highlights_body: This release updates Apple platform baselines, improves Android texture presentation, and reduces allocations in image and text-processing paths.

bullets.detail: Texture rendering now synchronizes with the display refresh cycle to provide smoother Android output.

bullets.lead: Front-buffered streams no longer retain data
bullets.detail: Fixes stream lifetime handling so front-buffered stream data can be released when it is no longer needed.

bullets.lead: Image pixel copies are more efficient
bullets.detail: Managed image pixel-copy operations avoid unnecessary work, reducing overhead when applications transfer image data.

bullets.lead: Text feature processing avoids native allocations
bullets.detail: Feature strings no longer require an avoidable native allocation while preserving their existing decoding behavior.
HarfBuzzSharp pools UTF-32 encoding buffers to reduce allocations during text shaping.
Apple-targeted applications must target the updated minimum deployment versions supported by this release.

bullets.lead: WebGPU implementation ships in the native library
bullets.detail: The WebGPU implementation is now included in libSkiaSharp.a, making its native support available to consumers.
Bundled HarfBuzz functions are bound locally on Linux to make native loading more reliable alongside other libraries.

contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Improved Linux HarfBuzz linkage and stabilized the Blazor CPU sample test
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bundled the WebGPU implementation in the native SkiaSharp library
